unciv.description:
Unciv is a free, open-source turn-based 4X strategy game inspired by Civilization V, bringing deep civilization-building gameplay to Android and desktop devices without advertisements or in-app purchases.

Build your civilization from the ground up, explore a hexagonal world, establish cities, research technologies, manage resources, and develop your military. Compete with rival civilizations through diplomacy, trade, cultural development, scientific progress, or military conquest as you work toward victory.

Unciv offers multiple difficulty levels, customizable game settings, an in-game Civilopedia, and single-player gameplay against computer-controlled civilizations. Online multiplayer lets you compete with other players, while a built-in map editor and community-created mods provide opportunities to customize your experience.

Designed with simple, efficient graphics rather than resource-intensive animations, Unciv focuses on strategic depth and accessibility. The game is actively developed by an open-source community and supports a range of languages.

Unciv can be played offline in single-player mode. Internet access is required for multiplayer, downloading mods, and other online features. Source code is available under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
